patrolRules.name: Inquisitorial Sanction
patrolRules.text: [Combat Patrol mission card shown under 'YOUR MISSION' on the Battle Setup screen — not a patrol ability card.] ANY BATTLE ROUND — When: End of your turn. For each enemy CHARACTER model destroyed in this or the previous turn: 10VP. SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS — When: End of your turn. You control two or more objectives: 5VP. You control one or more objectives: 5VP. END OF THE BATTLE — All enemy CHARACTER models are destroyed: 10VP. (A collapsed 'Lore' accordion was not expanded.)

patrolRules.name: Expansionary Campaign
patrolRules.text: [Combat Patrol mission card shown under 'OPPONENT'S MISSION' on the Battle Setup screen — belongs to the opposing patrol, identity not shown.] FIRST TO SECOND BATTLE ROUND — When: End of your turn. You control two or more expansion objectives: 15VP. You control one or more expansion objectives: 10VP. THIRD BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS — When: End of your turn. You control one or more expansion objectives: 5VP. You control two or more expansion objectives: 10VP. (A collapsed 'Lore' accordion was not expanded.)

enhancements.name: Killer Reflexes
enhancements.text: INQUISITOR'S HAND EVERSOR ASSASSIN model only. In the Fight phase, when this model is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, do not remove this model from the battlefield. When this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), this model is removed from the battlefield.

enhancements.name: Sanctic Slayers
enhancements.text: INQUISITOR'S HAND MINISTORUM PRIEST model only. (Once per turn, per unit) When a friendly INQUISITOR'S HAND unit is selected to attack you can use this ability. If you do, that unit's attacks that target a unit with a T greater than or equal to your attack's S have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Urban Enforcers
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly INQUISITOR'S HAND unit with every model within a terrain area.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP.

stratagems.name: Superior Weaponry
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly INQUISITOR'S HAND unit (excluding EVERSOR ASSASSIN units) is selected to attack.

stratagems.name: Inquisitorial Mandate
stratagems.target: One friendly INQUISITOR'S HAND unit (excluding EVERSOR ASSASSIN units).
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
